description: Favo — Colore: Adriatico & gold Collezione: Crossroads, The Philosopher's Stone, Imago Codice: 5836 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Tribal Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 140.5 cm Rapporto: 134 cm × 35.5 cm Toni: Blue-green Italian for honeycomb, FAVO is a geometric printed cotton organized around one of nature's most efficient structural forms. Its hexagonal repetition references the logic of the beehive: individual units, identical in form, gaining their full meaning only through their relationship to one another. It is a pattern about interconnectivity and collective beauty, rendered with the precision of our printing process and the warmth of our signature color palette. The repeat makes FAVO highly versatile: effective on upholstery where the geometric structure creates visual rhythm without overpowering, on cushion panels where the honeycomb can be read as a complete unit, and on drapery where it reads as a quiet, ordered field. Part of the IMAGO collection .
